summary: Round-2 repair of the mixed-extent / mixed-SEW runtime-region family. Re-enabled T028's disabled segment-level restructure (a100c/lower/vectorize.py _is_mixed_extent_region) and completed its design: every block carry of a restructured loop stages through the workspace (the staging analysis stages init and end value; the back-edge copy is the loop-carried memory phi), a restructured if's block joins write a join-owned region at BOTH arm closes (one-armed forms fall back to the pre-if value), regions hosting a reduce whose partial a later statement of the same body consumes also restructure (the consumer reads the merged value, not the per-chunk vred state -- argmax_kernel_inner's recorded wrong-index defect), and the rank-0 reduce taint in the stage plan covers in-region reduces. Repaired the mir-verifier consequence classes the same staging reproduced: scalar srem (the preduce kept/reduced decomposition now uses the division's complement AND the axis's own stride -- the [i+1] indexing collapsed multi-kept-axis forms onto the major axis), the e1-vector bool block (tl.zeros(int1) is the mask form), the smove(i8->i64) bool scalar load (the zext byte load binds the i64 class), the mixed-width indexed store (the store runs in the VALUE's region), the reshape/realize passthrough in the pointer whole-tree walk, the leading-axis rank padding in the staged lane map, the same-SEW lane-group normalization (vmovv) in the offset sum, the scalar-convert re-materialization, the layout/preduce result name binding, the unique scan loop tag (duplicate 'scanp.head' block names), the path-scoped workspace bases, and the argument-load rematerialization class in the allocator. The full compile sweep: 2116 identities, 1788 artifacts (+290 vs the 1498 recorded census), 328 refusals (-289 vs 617), 0 crashes (was 1). The owned family is at ZERO rows: 'a runtime region mixes block extents' 374->0, 'smove preserves width' 9->0, "block name 'scanp.head' defined twice" 9->0, "use-before-definition 'wsprN'" 7->0, 'vstoreix value SEW must match the region' 3->0, multi-lane broadcast refusal 12->0. Residual (located, different operators -- the next defect layer the repair exposed): vsetvli-region-inconsistency 24 rows (operators that previously refused at 'mixes block extents': conv2d_add, gelu_conv2d, ldl_factor, leaky_relu_conv2d, hidden__prepare_wy_repr), scan data-SEW 6 rows (cumprod_dim1, unchanged from before), allocation non-convergence 81 rows (the restructure's staging pressure on chunk_gated_delta/chunk_retention/adaptive families), plus a new located mif-join use-before-definition class (6 rows, cross_entropy) and a merge-frame disagreement class (3 rows, nansum_kernel_2). All 36 test files pass (test_t032_repairs.py added with 11 executed checks; the two T028 refusal witnesses updated to executed comparisons; test_stage_plan's accumulate-form classification updated for the taint generalization). 25 spot-execution rows over the family's own operators at 1 and 4 workers under their declared policies: 0 hard failures. DISCLOSURE: early in the task a filtered sweep accidentally overwrote docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.json (its default --census-out); the file was fully regenerated by the final full sweep (tests[0]) whose output is the canonical post-fix census now in place.
